description: This lumpy oversized toad is a real stinker!  A miasma like rotted onions coated in rancid peanut butter surrounds it.  Even approaching it makes your eyes water and your throat tighten until you're coughing to catch breath.  It doesn't help that its leathery skin looks to be coated in a thick greasy substance, no doubt related to the creature's horrid odor.

special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: %s catches you with its tongue and pulls you in!

//: When possible, add an AOE burst & temporary trail of slippery, toxic grease on several hour cooldown.  The toad can expel grease like a squid with ink.  The grease offgasses into something between tear gas and a blister agent, hence the smell.  NO_BREATHE flag is to prevent self-gassing.

description: On thick, over-proportioned legs, this large treefrog slings its weight with notable force.  It doesn't seem dangerous, but its size is still cause for concern.  Even scrunched up, it is as large as a Thanksgiving turkey.
